title: Intervene, Calibrate, Discover: Learning Causal Structure from Pixels
abstract: arXiv:2610.34711v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning high-level causal variables from low-level observations is a central problem for artificial intelligence. With known node semantics but an unknown graph, visual readout errors can misalign model settings with environment intervention values. We address this mismatch by pairing image readouts with verified values attained through fixed round-robin interventions. With encoder and decoder frozen, a dimension-wise invertible calibration map puts visual responses and target settings in shared numerical units. After freezing this map, the agent selects interventions to resolve graph directions and fits local mechanisms to predict consequences; inverse calibration returns counterfactual states to the decoder's original coordinates. Across Domino, Pick-and-Place, Balance, Gears, CAUSAL3D, and CausalWorld, we evaluate graph discovery, intervention consequences, and counterfactual images. translated_title: 干预、校准、发现：从像素中学习因果结构
translated_abstract: 从低层观测中学习高层因果变量是人工智能的一个核心问题。在节点语义已知但图结构未知的情况下，视觉读出误差可能导致模型设置与环境干预值之间出现错位。我们通过将图像读出与经固定轮换干预获得的已验证值进行配对来解决这一不匹配问题。在编码器和解码器冻结的情况下，一个逐维度可逆的校准映射将视觉响应与目标设置置于共享的数值单位中。在冻结该映射后，智能体选择干预以解析图的方向，并拟合局部机制来预测后果；逆向校准则将反事实状态还原到解码器的原始坐标系中。在多米诺、抓取放置、平衡、齿轮、CAUSAL3D 和 CausalWorld 等环境中，我们评估了图发现、干预后果和反事实图像的生成。受控多米诺实验表明，干预……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种通过固定轮换干预将视觉读出与已验证干预值配对校准的方法，使智能体在编码器与解码器冻结的条件下能够从像素中学习因果图结构、预测干预后果并生成反事实图像。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes calibrating visual readouts with verified intervention values obtained through fixed round-robin interventions, enabling agents to learn causal graph structures from pixels, predict intervention consequences, and generate counterfactual images.
